source_instruction: look for a high speed coaxial cable that is about 1 foot. three per pack would be nice.
query: Ugh, I spent my whole morning trying to troubleshoot why my kitchen toaster keeps burning every slice of sourdough I put in it, even on the lowest setting, and I think I might need to replace the crumb tray that somehow got warped when my cousin used it to reheat leftover pizza last weekend. Also, my neighbor stopped by earlier to rant about how the community garden’s tomato plants are all getting eaten by tiny hornworms and none of the organic sprays they’ve tried are working at all. Anyway, I’m browsing the satellite television section right now and I need something with ultra-fast latency, plus the 1ft - 3 pack option, and it can’t cost more than $40 total.
